findings.motion: Joint author of SB 144, requiring a voter to present proof of identification
findings.note: Listed in the author line (with Menendez, Eckhardt, Gutierrez) of SB 144. The introduced text accepts a wider list of photo and non-photo documents, lets a voter without photo ID vote with a reasonable-impediment declaration, and sets provisional-ballot cure by ID or affidavit. Referred to State Affairs on 2025-02-03 and went no further. Date is the bill's filing date.
subjects: provisional ballot for voter with no ID
